clayresearch.message: BASE compiler work should distinguish executable ExprIR, declarative PredicateIR/ConstraintIR and explicitly owned protocol/research surfaces instead of expanding one grammar blindly.

frank.message: FRANK loop-of-loops remains representable without a new cognitive primitive, but relation/control clauses need typed canonical relation identity; three current G9 rule clauses require explicit semantic freeze before compilation.

gwt.message: Machine-extractable selection/broadcast/use/outcome/reentry relations should lower to typed non-authorizing PredicateIR; relation existence or parser success is not causal credit.

emergenz.message: Compiler relation closure does not strengthen emergence or consciousness claims. Intervention/lesion/rescue/shuffle controls remain unchanged.

claycode.message: Minimal <,>,<=,>= repair is insufficient: 33/53 G9 rules fit patched ExprIR; registry-gated PredicateIR lifts deterministic coverage to 50/53. Fail closed on the remaining three until authoritative meaning is frozen.

hyperposition.message: Higher-order relation roles/order must be explicit in canonical IR. Operand ordering changed semantic hash in 10000/10000 tested binary predicate swaps.

claygraph.message: Existing typed hyperrelation members/provenance/authority separation are compatible. ClayCode relation resolution must not promote graph activation or derived relation to authority.

unifieddb.message: Relation signatures/semantic hashes can participate in persisted semantic identity, but UnifiedDB execution truth/capability observations remain separate from compiler relation resolution and physical consolidation is not implied.

harness.message: Add production parser fixtures for current G9 rule corpus, three ambiguous clauses, unknown-relation rejection, semantic-hash whitespace invariance and operand-order mutation before H1 release freeze.

shared_ancestry_note: The concurrent typed-RelationIR oracle is treated as same-project sibling evidence. This run adds a distinct full-corpus closure/adversarial test but does not count mere agreement as independent replication.
